title: Towards a Consistent Measure of Model Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the AUC Gap, which measures the largest disparity in predictive performance (Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve) across different gender subgroups or intersectional gender-race groups.
Calculating the AUC Gap, which measures the maximum difference in test AUC across different racial subgroups or intersectional gender-race groups.
Calculating the AUC Gap to quantify the worst-case performance gap in predictive accuracy (test AUC) among subgroups with varying levels of Socioeconomic Status (SES).
Calculating the AUC Gap to assess performance disparities (differences in test AUC) among subgroups based on their varying levels of prior knowledge.
